_comment: Performance budget (pipeline/README.md). The gate reads the preset the run used; `budgetPreset` is the preset the harness runs by default (the owner's choice, 2026-10-04: Low carries the 60 fps target on a low-spec laptop). Frame-time lines (p95Ms, p99Ms) are gated only in the environments listed in frameTimeGatedEnvs: everywhere else they are reported, not judged (no GPU in the cloud container). Draw calls and triangles are set below the owner's ceilings (150, 250k) because today's scene uses 35 and 47k on Low: a doubling must fail. `ticks` is the measured window per environment in simulation ticks (3600 is 60 s of play; the container's simulation runs at about 16 ticks/s in software, so 1800 ticks takes about two minutes there). Raise a line with a DECISIONS entry.
